description: This file defines a React context provider for managing user session state in a Solana wallet-based application. It handles loading, saving, connecting, and disconnecting wallet sessions, utilizing external storage and wallet connection utilities.

methods.name: Providers
methods.description: React functional component that provides session management via Context to its children.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Asynchronously connects a wallet for the specified role, updates session state, and persists the session.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Asynchronously disconnects the wallet and clears the session.
